domain.description: A San Francisco Bay Area bike-share trip log. Each row is one rental trip: start/end station, start/end time, duration, which bike was used, the rider's subscription type, and the zip code they registered with.
domain.source_note: Spider (Yu et al., 2018) benchmark database bike_1, used as-is -- schema and data are third-party, not authored for this project.
domain.register_table_note: The real bike_1 database has 4 tables (station, status, trip, weather). weather scored highest by raw column-richness (22 numeric columns) and has slightly more real single-table questions (14 vs trip's 10), but is a temperature/humidity/wind/pressure log, not bike-sharing data -- a domain literally named 'bike_1' whose answerable content was mostly weather would be a confusing choice. 'trip' was chosen instead for thematic coherence, a robust row count, and real categorical variety (subscription_type), at the cost of a thinner answer-query count than wta_1/world_1 -- flagged for review, not silently accepted.
